question: Who built 'Dinpanah' on the mound of ancient Indraprastha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Humayun**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Humayun**, the second **Mughal Emperor**, laid the foundation of the city of **Dinpanah** in the year **1533 AD**.
 
• The city was constructed on the ancient mound of **Indraprastha**, a site traditionally associated with the capital of the **Pandavas** from the epic **Mahabharata**.
 
• The name **Dinpanah** translates to "**Refuge of the Faith**," reflecting Humayun's vision of creating a cosmopolitan hub for scholars and holy men from various parts of the Islamic world. ***Hence, the statement regarding Humayun is correct.***
